items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: We, we, uh, Parquet composed that. Ah, S.H.I.E.L.D. Barquet, that one? Yes, sir. Yes, sir. Him and Yellow Nunez.

ctx.x: What about Barquet? How old was he?
Barquet was just around about my age. What about Gilles Rouge?
Who? The piccolo player, Gilles Rouge. Gilles. Gilles Rouge.
